GOAL
Build a premium event landing page for **“ARTIFACT: Museum Night”** — a ticketed night museum event with ticket selection, but no real payment.

TECH / STRICT
- One html file only.
- HTML, CSS, and Vanilla JavaScript only.
- No frameworks.
- No libraries.
- Inline CSS and inline JS.
- Remote images are allowed.
- Must work by opening the file directly in a browser.

DESIGN DIRECTION
Create a visually striking cinematic museum-night website.

The design should feel like:
- luxury museum after dark
- velvet darkness
- golden spotlights
- quiet mystery
- art-house cinema
- premium cultural event

Visual style:
- dark velvet / near-black background
- deep burgundy and midnight navy gradients
- soft spotlight effects
- elegant serif headlines
- modern readable sans-serif body text
- thin gold dividers
- subtle grain/noise overlay using CSS only
- large editorial hero layout
- asymmetric image cards
- glass-like dark panels
- premium ticket cards
- smooth hover states
- scroll reveal animations
- strong typography hierarchy

Color palette:
- Background: `#070506`
- Velvet: `#1a0710`
- Burgundy: `#3a0f1d`

- Gold: `#d6ad60`
- Soft gold: `#f3d79b`
- Ivory text: `#f8efe2`
- Muted text: `#b9a999`
- Panel: `rgba(255, 244, 220, 0.06)`
- Border: `rgba(214, 173, 96, 0.28)`

TYPOGRAPHY
Use CSS font stacks only:
- Headlines: `Georgia`, `Times New Roman`, serif
- Body: `Inter`, `system-ui`, `Segoe UI`, sans-serif

LAYOUT
Single-page landing with sticky navbar and smooth scrolling.

SECTIONS

1. Navbar
- Logo: ARTIFACT
- Links:
  - Program

  - FAQ

  “ARTIFACT: Museum Night”
